title: Introduce Contextualized Ground-Truth Sampling Gate and CI Adapter
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Some regressions only surface when the model is evaluated against ground-truth examples that share contextual attributes with production requests (e.g., system prompt fragments, domain tokens, metadata flags). This PR adds a Contextualized Ground-Truth Sampling Gate: a lightweight CI hook that draws small, context-conditioned ground-truth samples and runs a fast suite of evals to detect regressions tied to context drift. The change includes: 1) a sampling component (ContextualSampler) that matches production-like context fingerprints (sequence length, instruction tokens, metadata tags) and constructs a stratified mini-batch; 2) a gating policy (GateEvaluator) that computes composite signals (exact-match recall, token-level likelihood delta, and a contextual rank metric) and applies a thresholded policy with hysteresis and burn-in; 3) a CI adapter for GitHub Actions that runs the gate on PRs touching model-serving/adapter code and fails early on statistically significant degradations; 4) an automatic rollback / guidance path that posts a triage checklist to the PR when the gate fails, with links to debugging tips and a small replay harness. Design notes: - The sampler uses lightweight fingerprint vectors extracted from a historical request ledger and proactively samples k=50 examples across three strata: short-instruction, long-dialogue, and metadata-heavy. Sampling is randomized but seeded by the PR head SHA to keep runs reproducible. - Gate evaluator computes a composite score: score = 0.5*EM_normalized + 0.3*(-KL_token_delta) + 0.2*contextual_rank. We include a short bootstrap baseline derived from the last green main run. - Hysteresis: the gate will soft-fail on first detection (comment + set status=neutral) and hard-fail on repeated failures over two successive runs to reduce flakiness. - Runtime constraints: the gate aims for <5m wall time by default; longer runs are allowed for release/* branches. Testing and validation: - Local unit tests for ContextualSampler + GateEvaluator (coverage added) - Integration smoke that runs with a minimal model stub (fast) in CI - Stress experiment: ran on 120 sample PRs from the last 6 months; the gate caught 7 context-conditioned regressions that were missed by aggregate metrics and had zero false positives in a manually-reviewed subset. Backwards compatibility: the adapter is opt-in via a repo-level eval.yml toggle. The PR includes sensible defaults so teams can enable it conservatively. Operational hooks: - A dashboard metric (eval_gates.contextual_gt.score) was added to allow SRE to monitor gate stability. - A small alert flavor is included if gate flaps more than 3 times in a 24h window. Usage: To enable, add eval: contextual_gt: enabled: true to .github/eval.yml or flip the repo toggle in the console. The PR body includes examples of the minimal config and the sample output format. Related work: inspired by production incident SUP-4421 where a prompt-anchored regression went undetected by global evals. Related Linear ENG-2021 tracks the broader CI gating roadmap. Summary: this change materially improves sensitivity to context-conditioned regressions while balancing runtime and flakiness via hysteresis and burn-in.

discussion: Diego Alvarez (reviewer): Can we avoid touching the historical ledger directly in the CI container? Suggested extracting a small summarized fingerprint store as an artifact.
Maya Chen (author): Good point — changed sampler to read compressed fingerprint snapshots (see ci/actions/contextual-gt.yml).
Priya Singh (reviewer): The composite weighting looks reasonable but please add an easy knob for teams to prefer EM or likelihood-based signals.
Maya Chen (author): Added per-repo config overrides and documented them in docs/eval_gates.md.
Owen Patel (reviewer): CI time budget needs to be explicit. Ensure default is 3 minutes for PRs and 10m for release branches.
Maya Chen (author): Adjusted GH action timeout and added comments in the workflow file.
QA (automated): integration smoke passed against model stub on first run, second run validated baseline recalibration.
release_notes: Add a new contextualized ground-truth sampling gate and CI adapter to detect context-conditioned regressions. Opt-in via .github/eval.yml. Adds metrics and an alert flavor for gate stability.
